Launch requires a successful delivery test on a real handset and a successful same-day opt-out rehearsal by Alder desk staff. The delivery test passed. The rehearsal is the remaining launch gate. The service desk needs to restore access so staff can complete the rehearsal. [Pilot log](evidence/alder-pilot-log.txt) |

**Where to record it:** `tasks.md` has been the authoritative task record since May 10. FableDesk is connected for review links and status sync is disabled. Its May 13 export still shows BP-4 open and BP-5 done, with BP-5 closed automatically by a merge rule.
